headline: 黑鸽幻视领跑，今日院线空档
headlineEn: Black Dove and Vision Quest Lead; No New Releases Today
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅2部新片入市；电影端《野兽之心》《生化危机：爆发夜》热度领先，剧集端《幻视任务》《黑鸽》持续领跑，跨媒介话题集中。
summaryEn: No new films open today, with only two new movies this week; Heart of the Beast and Resident Evil: Outbreak Night lead film buzz, while Vision Quest and Black Dove continue to top TV attention, concentrating cross-format discussion.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，本周仅2部新片入市，院线供给偏冷。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new films open today; only two new movies arrive this week, keeping theatrical supply light.

industryHighlights.text: 《黑鸽》同时出现在电影与剧集今日热度榜，跨媒介关注度显眼。
industryHighlights.en: Black Dove appears on both today's movie and TV trending lists, showing notable cross-format attention.

industryHighlights.text: 电影周榜《生化危机：爆发夜》《野兽之心》领先，剧集周榜《幻视任务》《黑鸽》居前。
industryHighlights.en: Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Heart of the Beast lead the weekly movie chart, while Vision Quest and Black Dove rank high on TV.

industryHighlights.text: 本周热门片单仍见《哥斯拉-0.0》《黄金时段》，暂无重点待映项目。
industryHighlights.en: This week's hot list still includes Godzilla-0.0 and Primetime; no major upcoming titles are flagged.
